C0888.title: Leshan Police Crack Massive Student Personal Information Infringement Case
C0888.summary: From April to June 2026, Leshan police cracked a major student personal information infringement case spanning 17 cities and prefectures in Sichuan, coordinating with police in Deyang, Meishan, Chengdu, and other places. They dismantled a black-market chain that illegally leaked and resold student information for profit and sealed more than 900,000 student information records involved in the case.
